entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for User, Session, and Agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available via an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It provides automated fact extraction and user profile maintenance with connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading. It is designed to reduce token spend and provides observable retrieval through directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents generates cited prose answers and includes explicit gap analysis for missing information. It supports multi-user institutional memory with login-scoped privacy and extracts typed entity edges without LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system facilitates long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and is accessible via Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library serves as the upstream library for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It offers a FastAPI server with hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection via Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like versioning (commit, branch, and merge). It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system utilizes a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context. It integrates vector search and structured facts using a local infrastructure of Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This context harness generates playbooks, hints, and datasets from task iterations to assist agents with complex tasks. It supports local and remote models and includes an offline mode to prevent outbound network connections.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a DAG-based engine and a SQLite-backed message store to prevent message loss. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG and provides tools for searching compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides portable identity, memory, and secrets for agents including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Codex. It automates memory creation from transcripts and imported files, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It supports Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code while providing local-first, zero-cost search.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search and integrates through MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool accelerates long context LLM inference by using block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, local-first architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by including a why_retrieved tag with every retrieval. It supports in-process embedded mode by default and includes features like contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide purpose-built evidence packets to the agent.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by watching agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server that uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags for bidirectional relationships.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only the necessary context. It supports stdio and SSE MCP servers and is local-first with no account required.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces tool-schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings in prompt tokens.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to manage information through importance-weighted recall and BM25 keyword search. It prioritizes high-priority memories during context prefetch and supports named graph relationships between entries.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory provider, this plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking prefetch operations. It ensures data hygiene by supporting immediate event deletion without leaving persistent summaries.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It maintains reliability via a local SQLite layer and write outbox, offering tools to search, update, and remember state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows Hermes agents to manage financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It facilitates an autonomous payment model where APIs can charge for services and agents can pay for themselves.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and enhances retrieval through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and can be executed via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon. It utilizes HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication to manage long-term data.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for managing artifacts. It includes a proactive router skill and supports an opt-in process for automatic tool-OKF generation.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Featuring 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal, this provider uses hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also implements automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve relevant information.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories, supporting both semantic and literal searches. It enables grounded Q&A with specific file-and-line citations while running entirely on localhost.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a software development methodology utilizing subagent-driven development for engineering tasks. It emphasizes TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles while supporting harnesses such as Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It includes an MCP server for integration with coding agents and uses DESIGN.md for brand system definitions.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It features built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement to unify skills across agents and devices. It integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills that preserve state in a docs/ folder. These are available as spec-conformant Agent Plugins compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill provides adjudication for agent-to-agent deals, including escrow and dispute resolution. It connects fragmented ecosystem layers using natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection includes 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides ready-to-paste exports for ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and Codex.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides access to YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists. It is powered by TranscriptAPI and is compatible with the Agent Skills format.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It provides findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots to improve reasoning quality.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents using a three-level work model. It provides structured memory via file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This repository provides specialized skills for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specific skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard for Hermes Agent users.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides prompting guides for FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 models along with API integration documentation. It includes a suite of six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool extracts function signatures and types from code and documentation to create agentskills.io-compliant skills. It produces version-pinned skills that include an audit trail.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It features real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This workflow language for AI uses a single Rust binary to provide intent as code through four verbs. It enables local-first execution with any LLM and provides static auditing via nika check alongside tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon architecture to maintain persistent connections and allows for incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill implements a 5-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and reasoning capability while tracking quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It features a deterministic pre-scan layer and an MCP server that generates suppression rules to reduce false positives.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub provides community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation by implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face and operates autonomously via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures to implement multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for managing persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness to simplify code. It employs a risk-tiered triage system for modifications and includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides 2,077 total skills and 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and OWASP.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC through protocols such as Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Provides functional quality certification for AI agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker environments. The system produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and offers a public API for verification.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: Generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. The tool produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions, utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Offers a suite of tools including video-to-text for local or Douyin links, document OCR for scans and PDFs, and an e-commerce material studio. These skills are compatible with the agentskills.io open standard.

entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers a Termux-based installer and guide for deploying Hermes Agent on Android devices using proot-distro. It supports local models via Ollama and is compatible with multiple AI model providers.

entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. The setup integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing using NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and includes configurable security policies for web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It allows for building specific Hermes tags via build arguments and supports persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module facilitates reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is designed to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces from a single web application. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project provides a production-ready, headless systemd deployment for Ubuntu and Debian servers. It configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable Hermes Agent package is distributed via GitHub Releases and can run as a TUI, Desktop app, or Gateway. It includes bundled CPython 3.12 and PortableGit, allowing for side-by-side execution with an existing Hermes installation.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multi-agent LLM financial trading, incorporating fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It facilitates structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers and supports Docker deployment.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers container sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system features a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis. It is designed for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs using Hermes and Ollama without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It runs 100% locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux and includes an auto-sync feature.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool and visualization dashboard tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It enables users to monitor consumption for various clients such as Gemini CLI.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of coding-agent API traffic from Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other tools. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It features multi-device sync and customizable dashboard modules.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating applications with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configurations.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without OAuth or separate processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP and supports providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It includes a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and undo functionality for recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph, alongside memory apps for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram. It also offers a plugin for Claude Code featuring automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through preconfigured CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance and offers automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder local configurations and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services to deploy a stack in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It identifies missing stop conditions, unbounded retries, and ambiguous or overlapping tool descriptions using HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps OpenClaw configs and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files to establish config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides fully local, offline interaction with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages sessions, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics. It supports 10 platform channels, including Telegram and Discord, and includes visual workflow building and Kanban task tracking.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It utilizes tmux-backed workers and includes a full workspace file browser with Monaco and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and other CLI agents. It supports delegation to sub-agents and provides native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for shell access.

entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard serves as a comprehensive control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and ZOO Swarm kanban pipelines. It features a browser-based terminal and real-time chat with tool call visualization to monitor agent health and system metrics.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit that provides a searchable history for various coding-agent CLIs while tracking live quota burn per session. It operates entirely locally without telemetry, functioning as a private analytics and limits tracker for Hermes users.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It distinguishes itself by integrating a WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for hands-free interaction.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this project offers a terminal-based alternative for chatting with agents and managing their sessions. It includes a dedicated kanban board for task management alongside tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: This Next.js and React-based dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It is specifically designed with an approval inbox to manage and authorize agent requests that have side effects.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA that brings Hermes functionality to the Telegram Mini App platform with HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and includes a terminal chat with file attachment capabilities.

It features a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers and supports local models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It centralizes the management of skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers within a task-tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring-focused dashboard tracks session activity and costs in real time while allowing users to inspect conversation histories. It provides read-only access to environment variables and configuration settings for secure process oversight.
